name: Kusakabe Sanae
source:
The mother of the family. She is gentle and is always smiling. The family is the most important to her.

[spoiler]Since the husband is working away and hasn't returned to the house for months, she starts having sexual interest in her son.
A mysterious man tricks her into letting him inside the house and rapes her. Later she accepts to keep having sex with him and other men.[/spoiler]
